relatedItems.titleZh: 威廉姆斯车队卡洛斯晋级Q2，亚历克斯止步Q1
relatedItems.summaryZh: 卡洛斯在排位赛中晋级到Q2，位列第16位；亚历克斯则排在第17位，未能晋级。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Carlos is through to Q2 in P16 ⏰ That’s the end of Alex’s qualifying as he finishes in P17.
relatedItems.summaryEn:
Carlos is through to Q2 in P16 ⏰
That’s the end of Alex’s qualifying as he finishes in P17.
detailZh: 卡洛斯是威廉姆斯车队的车手，他在排位赛中成功晋级到Q2，位列第16位。而亚历克斯，同样是威廉姆斯车队的车手，他的排位赛到此结束，最终排名第17位。
detailEn:
Carlos is through to Q2 in P16 ⏰
That’s the end of Alex’s qualifying as he finishes in P17.
